sections.label: Book 13
sections.name: The fire altar: the first layer of bricks

verses.sa: मयि गृह्णाम्यग्रे अग्निं रायस्पोषाय सुप्रजास्त्वाय सुवीर्याय। मामु देवताः सचन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: mayi gṛhṇāmyagre agniṃ rāyaspoṣāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāya māmu devatāḥ sacantām
verses.en: I TAKE within me Agni first, for increase of my wealth, good offspring, manly strength: So may the Deities wait on me.

verses.sa: अपां पृष्ठमसि योनिरग्नेः समुद्रमभितः पिन्वमानम्। वर्धमानो महाँ२ आ च पुष्करे दिवो मात्रया वरिम्णा प्रथस्व॥
verses.tr: apāṃ pṛṣṭhamasi yoniragneḥ samudramabhitaḥ pinvamānam vardhamāno mahāṃ2 ā ca puṣkare divo mātrayā varimṇā prathasva
verses.en: Thou art the waters' back, the womb of Agni, around the ocean as it swells and surges. Waxing to greatness, resting on the lotus, spread forth in c amplitude with heaven's own measure.

verses.sa: ब्रह्म जज्ञानं प्रथमं पुरस्ताद्वि सीमतः सुरुचो वेन आवः। स बुध्न्या उपमा अस्य विष्ठाः सतश्च योनिमसतश्च वि वः॥
verses.tr: brahma jajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastādvi sīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ sa budhnyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataśca yonimasataśca vi vaḥ
verses.en: Eastward at first was Brahma generated. Vena o'erspread the bright Ones from the summit, Disclosed his deepest nearest revelations, womb of existent and of non-existent.

verses.sa: हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिरेक आसीत्। स दाधार पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, born Only Lord of all created being. He fixed and holdeth up this earth and heaven. Worship we Ka the God with our oblation.

verses.sa: द्रप्सश्चस्कन्द पृथिवीमनु द्यामिमं च योनिमनु यश्च पूर्वः। समानं योनिमनु सञ्चरन्तं द्रप्सं जुहोम्यनु सप्त होत्राः॥
verses.tr: drapsaścaskanda pṛthivīmanu dyāmimaṃ ca yonimanu yaśca pūrvaḥ samānaṃ yonimanu sañcarantaṃ drapsaṃ juhomyanu sapta hotrāḥ
verses.en: The Drop leaped onward through the earth and heaven, I offer up, throughout the seven oblations, the Drop still moving to the common dwelling.

verses.sa: नमोऽस्तु सर्पेभ्यो ये के च पृथिवीमनु। ये अन्तरिक्षे ये दिवि तेभ्यः सर्पेभ्यो नमः॥
verses.tr: namo'stu sarpebhyo ye ke ca pṛthivīmanu ye antarikṣe ye divi tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ
verses.en: Homage be paid to Serpents unto all of them that are on earth, To those that dwell in air, to those that dwell in sky be homage paid.

verses.sa: या इषवो यातुधानानां ये वा वनस्पतीँ१ रनु। ये वावटेषु शेरते तेभ्यः सर्पेभ्यो नमः॥
verses.tr: yā iṣavo yātudhānānāṃ ye vā vanaspatīṃ1 ranu ye vāvaṭeṣu śerate tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ
verses.en: To those that are the demons' dart$, to those that lire upon the trees, To all the Serpents that lie low in holes be adoration paid.

verses.sa: ये वामी रोचने दिवो ये वा सूर्यस्य रश्मिषु। येषामप्सु सदस्कृतं तेभ्यः सर्पेभ्यो नमः॥
verses.tr: ye vāmī rocane divo ye vā sūryasya raśmiṣu yeṣāmapsu sadaskṛtaṃ tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ
verses.en: Or those that are in heaven's bright sphere, or those that dwell in the Sun's beams: Serpents, whose home has been prepared in waters, homage unto them!

verses.sa: कृणुष्व पाजः प्रसितिं न पृथ्वीं याहि राजेवामवाँ२ इभेन। तृष्वीमनु प्रसितिं द्रूणानोऽस्तासि विध्य रक्षसस्तपिष्ठैः॥
verses.tr: kṛṇuṣva pājaḥ prasitiṃ na pṛthvīṃ yāhi rājevāmavāṃ2 ibhena tṛṣvīmanu prasitiṃ drūṇāno'stāsi vidhya rakṣasastapiṣṭhaiḥ
verses.en: Put forth like a wide spreading net thy vigour: go like a mighty King with his attendants. Thou, following thy swift net, shootest arrows: transfix the fiends with darts that burn most fiercely.

verses.sa: तव भ्रमास आशुया पतन्त्यनुस्पृश धृषता शोशुचानः। तपूंष्यग्ने जुह्वा पतङ्गानसन्दितो वि सृज विष्वगुल्काः॥
verses.tr: tava bhramāsa āśuyā patantyanuspṛśa dhṛṣatā śośucānaḥ tapūṃṣyagne juhvā pataṅgānasandito vi sṛja viṣvagulkāḥ
verses.en: Forth go in rapid flight thy whirling weapons: follow them 'closely glowing in thy fury. Spread with thy tongue the winged flames, O Agni: unfettered cast thy firebrands all around thee.

verses.sa: प्रति स्पशो वि सृज तूर्णितमो भवा पायुर्विशो अस्या अदब्धः। यो नो दूरे अघशंसो यो अन्त्यग्ने मा किष्टे व्यथिरा दधर्षीत्॥
verses.tr: prati spaśo vi sṛja tūrṇitamo bhavā pāyurviśo asyā adabdhaḥ yo no dūre aghaśaṃso yo antyagne mā kiṣṭe vyathirā dadharṣīt
verses.en: Send thy spies forward, fleetest in thy motion: be, ne'er deceived, the guardian of this people. From him who, near or far, is bent on evil, and let no trouble sent from thee o'ercome us.

verses.sa: उदग्ने तिष्ठ प्रत्या तनुष्व न्यमित्राँ२ ओषतात्तिग्महेते। यो नो अरातिं समिधान चक्रे नीचा तं धक्ष्यतसं न शुष्कम्॥
verses.tr: udagne tiṣṭha pratyā tanuṣva nyamitrāṃ2 oṣatāttigmahete yo no arātiṃ samidhāna cakre nīcā taṃ dhakṣyatasaṃ na śuṣkam
verses.en: Rise up, O Agui, spread thee out before us, burn down our foes, thou who hast sharpened Arrows. Him, blazing Agni! who hath worked us mischief, consume thou utterly like dried-up stubble.

verses.sa: ऊर्ध्वो भव प्रति विध्याध्यस्मदाविष्कृणुष्व दैव्यान्यग्ने। अव स्थिरा तनुहि यातुजूनां जामिमजामिं प्र मृणीहि शत्रून्। अग्नेष्ट्वा तेजसा सादयामि॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvo bhava prati vidhyādhyasmadāviṣkṛṇuṣva daivyānyagne ava sthirā tanuhi yātujūnāṃ jāmimajāmiṃ pra mṛṇīhi śatrūn agneṣṭvā tejasā sādayāmi
verses.en: Rise, Agni, drive off those who fight against us: make manifest thine own celestial vigour. Slacken the strong bows of the demon-driven: destroy our foemen whether kin or stranger. I settle thee with Agni's fiery ardour.

verses.sa: अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम्। अपां रेतांसि जिन्वति। इन्द्रस्य त्वौजसा सादयामि॥
verses.tr: agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati indrasya tvaujasā sādayāmi
verses.en: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he: He quickeneth the waters' seed. I settle thee with the great strength of Indra.

verses.sa: भुवो यज्ञस्य रजसश्च नेता यत्रा नियुद्भिः सचसे शिवाभिः। दिवि मूर्धानं दधिषे स्वर्षां जिह्वामग्ने चकृषे हव्यवाहम्॥
verses.tr: bhuvo yajñasya rajasaśca netā yatrā niyudbhiḥ sacase śivābhiḥ divi mūrdhānaṃ dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ jihvāmagne cakṛṣe havyavāham
verses.en: Thou art the leader of the rite and region to which with thine auspicious teams thou tendest. Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy tongue the oblation-bearer,.Agni!

verses.sa: ध्रुवाऽसि धरुणाऽऽस्तृता विश्वकर्मणा। मा त्वा समुद्र उद्वधीन्मा सुपर्णोऽव्यथमाना पृथिवीं दृंह॥
verses.tr: dhruvā'si dharuṇā''stṛtā viśvakarmaṇā mā tvā samudra udvadhīnmā suparṇo'vyathamānā pṛthivīṃ dṛṃha
verses.en: Steady art thou, sustainer, laid by Vi^vakarman in thy place. Let not the ocean nor the bird harm thee: unshaking, steady earth.

verses.sa: प्रजापतिष्ट्वा सादयत्वपां पृष्ठे समुद्रस्येमन्। व्यचस्वतीं प्रथस्वतीं प्रथस्व पृथिव्यसि॥
verses.tr: prajāpatiṣṭvā sādayatvapāṃ pṛṣṭhe samudrasyeman vyacasvatīṃ prathasvatīṃ prathasva pṛthivyasi
verses.en: Thee let Praj^pati settle on the waters' back, in Ocean's course, Thee the capacious, widely spread. Thou art the Wide One: spread thee wide!

verses.sa: भूरसि भूमिरस्यदितिरसि विश्वधाया विश्वस्य भुवनस्य धर्त्री। पृथिवीं यच्छ पृथिवीं दृंह पृथिवीं मा हिंसीः॥
verses.tr: bhūrasi bhūmirasyaditirasi viśvadhāyā viśvasya bhuvanasya dhartrī pṛthivīṃ yaccha pṛthivīṃ dṛṃha pṛthivīṃ mā hiṃsīḥ
verses.en: Thou art the earth, the ground, thou art the all-sustaining- Aditi, she who supporteth all the world. Control the earth, steady the earth, do thou the earth no injury.

verses.sa: विश्वस्मै प्राणायापानाय व्यानायोदानाय प्रतिष्ठायै चरित्राय। अग्निष्ट्वाऽभि पातु मह्या स्वस्त्या छर्दिषा शन्तमेन तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद॥
verses.tr: viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāyodānāya pratiṣṭhāyai caritrāya agniṣṭvā'bhi pātu mahyā svastyā chardiṣā śantamena tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda
verses.en: For all breath, out-breath, through-breath, upward-breathing, for high position, for prescribed observance, May Agni keep thee safe with great well-being, with the securest shelter. As aforetime with Angiras, with that Deity lie steady.

verses.sa: काण्डात्काण्डात्प्ररोहन्ती परुषः परुषस्परि। एवा नो दूर्वे प्र तनु सहस्रेण शतेन च॥
verses.tr: kāṇḍātkāṇḍātprarohantī paruṣaḥ paruṣaspari evā no dūrve pra tanu sahasreṇa śatena ca
verses.en: Upspringing from thine every joint, upspringing from each knot of thine. Thus with a thousand, D4rv&! I with a hundred do thou stretch us out.

verses.sa: या शतेन प्रतनोषि सहस्रेण विरोहसि। तस्यास्ते देवीष्टके विधेम हविषा वयम्॥
verses.tr: yā śatena pratanoṣi sahasreṇa virohasi tasyāste devīṣṭake vidhema haviṣā vayam
verses.en: Thou spreading with a hundred, thou that branohest with a thousand shoots,—Thee, such, with our oblation will we worship, O celestial Brick.

verses.sa: यास्ते अग्ने सूर्ये रुचो दिवमातन्वन्ति रश्मिभिः। ताभिर्नो अद्य सर्वाभी रुचे जनाय नस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: yāste agne sūrye ruco divamātanvanti raśmibhiḥ tābhirno adya sarvābhī ruce janāya naskṛdhi
verses.en: Thy lights, O Agni, in the Sun that with their beams overspread the sky,—With all of those assist thou us to-day to light and progeny.

verses.sa: या वो देवाः सूर्ये रुचो गोष्वश्वेषु या रुचः। इन्द्राग्नी ताभिः सर्वाभी रुचं नो धत्त बृहस्पते॥
verses.tr: yā vo devāḥ sūrye ruco goṣvaśveṣu yā rucaḥ indrāgnī tābhiḥ sarvābhī rucaṃ no dhatta bṛhaspate
verses.en: Lights of yours in the Sun, O Gods, or lights that are in kine and steeds, O Indra-Agni, with all those vouchsafe us light, Bpbaspati!

verses.sa: विराड्ज्योतिरधारयत्स्वराड्ज्योतिरधारयत्। प्रजापतिष्ट्वा सादयतु पृष्ठे पृथिव्या ज्योतिष्मतीम्। विश्वस्मै प्राणायापानाय व्यानाय विश्वं ज्योतिर्यच्छ। अग्निष्टेऽधिपतिस्तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद॥
verses.tr: virāḍjyotiradhārayatsvarāḍjyotiradhārayat prajāpatiṣṭvā sādayatu pṛṣṭhe pṛthivyā jyotiṣmatīm viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāya viśvaṃ jyotiryaccha agniṣṭe'dhipatistayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda
verses.en: The Far- Refulgent held the light. The Self -Refulgent held the light. Thee, luminous, may Prajslpati settle upon the back' of Earth. Give, to all breathing, all the light, to out-breath, to diffusive breath. Thy Sovran Lord' is Agni. With that Deity, as with Angiras, lie firmly settled in thy place.

verses.sa: मधुश्च माधवश्च वासन्तिकावृतू अग्नेरन्तः श्लेषोऽसि कल्पेतां द्यावापृथिवी कल्पन्तामाप ओषधयः कल्पन्तामग्नयः पृथङ्नम ज्यैष्ठ्याय सव्रताः। ये अग्नयः समनसोऽन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी इमे। वासन्तिकावृतू अभिकल्पमाना इन्द्रमिव देवा अभिसंविशन्तु तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवे सीदतम्॥
verses.tr: madhuśca mādhavaśca vāsantikāvṛtū agnerantaḥ śleṣo'si kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantāmāpa oṣadhayaḥ kalpantāmagnayaḥ pṛthaṅnama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ ye agnayaḥ samanaso'ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī ime vāsantikāvṛtū abhikalpamānā indramiva devā abhisaṃviśantu tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruve sīdatam
verses.en: Madhu and Madhava, the two Spring seasons—thou art the innermost cement of Agni. May Heaven and Earth, may Waters, Plants and Agnis help, separate, accordant, my precedence. May all the Fires, 'twixt heaven and earth, one minded, well-fitted, gather round these two Spring seasons, As the Gods gathering encompass Indra: firm with that Deity, Angiras-like, be seated.

verses.sa: अषाढाऽसि सहमाना सहस्वारातीः सहस्व पृतनायतः। सहस्रवीर्याऽसि सा मा जिन्व॥
verses.tr: aṣāḍhā'si sahamānā sahasvārātīḥ sahasva pṛtanāyataḥ sahasravīryā'si sā mā jinva
verses.en: Thou art Ash^h&, Conquering One. Conquer our foemen, conquer thou the men who fain would fight with us. A thousand manly powers hast thou: so do thou aid and quicken me.

verses.sa: मधु वाता ऋतायते मधु क्षरन्ति सिन्धवः। माध्वीर्नः सन्त्वोषधीः॥
verses.tr: madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ mādhvīrnaḥ santvoṣadhīḥ
verses.en: The winds waft sweets, the rivers pour sweets for the man who keeps the Law: So may the plants be sweet for us. as.

verses.sa: मधु नक्तमुतोषसो मधुमत्पार्थिवं रजः। मधु द्यौरस्तु नः पिता॥
verses.tr: madhu naktamutoṣaso madhumatpārthivaṃ rajaḥ madhu dyaurastu naḥ pitā
verses.en: Sweet be the night and sweet the dawns, sweet the terrestrial atmosphere: Sweet be our Father Heaven to us.

verses.sa: मधुमान्नो वनस्पतिर्मधुमाँ२ अस्तु सूर्यः। माध्वीर्गावो भवन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: madhumānno vanaspatirmadhumāṃ2 astu sūryaḥ mādhvīrgāvo bhavantu naḥ
verses.en: May the tall tree be full of sweets for as and. and fall of sweets the Sun: May our milch-kine be sweet for us.

verses.sa: अपां गम्भन्त्सीद मा त्वा सूर्योऽभि ताप्सीन्माऽग्निर्वैश्वानरः। अच्छिन्नपत्राः प्रजा अनुवीक्षस्वानु त्वा दिव्या वृष्टिः सचताम्॥
verses.tr: apāṃ gambhantsīda mā tvā sūryo'bhi tāpsīnmā'gnirvaiśvānaraḥ acchinnapatrāḥ prajā anuvīkṣasvānu tvā divyā vṛṣṭiḥ sacatām
verses.en: Seat thyself in the deepness of the waters, lest Surya, lest Vaisv&uara Agni scorch thee. With wing undipped, survey created beings: may rain I. that Cometh down from heaven attend thee.

verses.sa: त्रीन्त्समुद्रान्त्समसृपत् स्वर्गानपां पतिर्वृषभ इष्टकानाम्। पुरीषं वसानः सुकृतस्य लोके तत्र गच्छ यत्र पूर्वे परेताः॥
verses.tr: trīntsamudrāntsamasṛpat svargānapāṃ patirvṛṣabha iṣṭakānām purīṣaṃ vasānaḥ sukṛtasya loke tatra gaccha yatra pūrve paretāḥ
verses.en: He crept across the three heaven-reaching oceans, the Bull Glad in the world with his, the Well-Made's, vesture, go whither those before thee have departed.

verses.sa: मही द्यौः पृथिवी च न इमं यज्ञं मिमिक्षताम्। पिपृतां नो भरीमभिः॥
verses.tr: mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatām pipṛtāṃ no bharīmabhiḥ
verses.en: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, besprinkle this our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.

verses.sa: विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत यतो व्रतानि पस्पशे। इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा॥
verses.tr: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā
verses.en: Look ye on Vishnu's works whereby the Friend of Indra, close allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.

verses.sa: ध्रुवाऽसि धरुणेतो जज्ञे प्रथममेभ्यो योनिभ्यो अधि जातवेदाः। स गायत्र्या त्रिष्टुभाऽनुष्टुभा च देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतु प्रजानन्॥
verses.tr: dhruvā'si dharuṇeto jajñe prathamamebhyo yonibhyo adhi jātavedāḥ sa gāyatryā triṣṭubhā'nuṣṭubhā ca devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan
verses.en: Firm art thou, a sustainer. Hence engendered, forth from these wombs at first came Jatavedas. By GAyatrl, by Trishtup, by Anushtup, may be who knows bear to the Gods oblation.

verses.sa: इषे राये रमस्व सहसे द्युम्न ऊर्जे अपत्याय। सम्राडसि स्वराडसि सारस्वतौ त्वोत्सौ प्रावताम्॥
verses.tr: iṣe rāye ramasva sahase dyumna ūrje apatyāya samrāḍasi svarāḍasi sārasvatau tvotsau prāvatām
verses.en: Take thou thine ease for food, for store of riches, for might in splendour, and for strength and offspring. Thou art all-ruling, independent Ruler: both fountains of Sarasvati protect thee!

verses.sa: अग्ने युक्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वासो देव साधवः। अरं वहन्ति मन्यवे॥
verses.tr: agne yukṣvā hi ye tavāśvāso deva sādhavaḥ araṃ vahanti manyave
verses.en: O radiant Agni, harness thou thy steeds which are most excellent I They bear thee as thy spirit wills.

verses.sa: युक्ष्वा हि देवहूतमाँ२ अश्वाँ२ अग्ने रथीरिव। नि होता पूर्व्यः सदः॥
verses.tr: yukṣvā hi devahūtamāṃ2 aśvāṃ2 agne rathīriva ni hotā pūrvyaḥ sadaḥ
verses.en: Yoke, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invoke the Gods: As ancient Hotar take thy seat.

verses.sa: सम्यक् स्रवन्ति सरितो न धेना अन्तर्हृदा मनसा पूयमानाः। घृतस्य धारा अभि चाकशीमि हिरण्ययो वेतसो मध्ये अग्नेः॥
verses.tr: samyak sravanti sarito na dhenā antarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ ghṛtasya dhārā abhi cākaśīmi hiraṇyayo vetaso madhye agneḥ
verses.en: Like rivers our libations flow together, cleansing themselves in inmost heart and spirit. I look upon the flowing streams of butter: the golden reed is in the midst of Agni.

verses.sa: ऋचे त्वा रुचे त्वा भासे त्वा ज्योतिषे त्वा। अभूदिदं विश्वस्य भुवनस्य वाजिनमग्नेर्वैश्वानरस्य च॥
verses.tr: ṛce tvā ruce tvā bhāse tvā jyotiṣe tvā abhūdidaṃ viśvasya bhuvanasya vājinamagnervaiśvānarasya ca
verses.en: Thee for the praise, verse, thee for sheen, thee for bright splendour, thee for light. This hath become the energetic spirit of all the world and of Vaisvinara Agni.

verses.sa: अग्निर्ज्योतिषा ज्योतिष्मान् रुक्मो वर्चसा वर्चस्वान्। सहस्रदा असि सहस्राय त्वा॥
verses.tr: agnirjyotiṣā jyotiṣmān rukmo varcasā varcasvān sahasradā asi sahasrāya tvā
verses.en: Agni, all-luminous with light, splendid with splendour, golden One. Giver of thousands art thou: for a thousand thee.

verses.sa: आदित्यं गर्भं पयसा समङ्धि सहस्रस्य प्रतिमां विश्वरूपम्। परि वृङ्धि हरसा माऽभि मंस्थाः शतायुषं कृणुहि चीयमानः॥
verses.tr: ādityaṃ garbhaṃ payasā samaṅdhi sahasrasya pratimāṃ viśvarūpam pari vṛṅdhi harasā mā'bhi maṃsthāḥ śatāyuṣaṃ kṛṇuhi cīyamānaḥ
verses.en: Balm thou with milk the unborn babe Aditya, wearing all forms, creator of a thousand. Spare him with heat, nor plot against him: give him a hundred years of life while thou art building.

verses.sa: वातस्य जूतिं वरुणस्य नाभिमश्वं जज्ञानं सरिरस्य मध्ये। शिशुं नदीनां हरिमद्रिबुध्नमग्ने मा हिंसीः परमे व्योमन्॥
verses.tr: vātasya jūtiṃ varuṇasya nābhimaśvaṃ jajñānaṃ sarirasya madhye śiśuṃ nadīnāṃ harimadribudhnamagne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyoman
verses.en: The wind's impetuous rush, Varuna's navel! I the horse w that springs to life amid the waters! The rivers' tawny child, based on the mountain, harm not, O Agni, ii\ in the loftiest region.

verses.sa: अजस्रमिन्दुमरुषं भुरण्युमग्निमीडे पूर्वचित्तिं नमोभिः। स पर्वभिरृतुशः कल्पमानो गां मा हिंसीरदितिं विराजम्॥
verses.tr: ajasramindumaruṣaṃ bhuraṇyumagnimīḍe pūrvacittiṃ namobhiḥ sa parvabhirṛtuśaḥ kalpamāno gāṃ mā hiṃsīraditiṃ virājam
verses.en: Unwasting Drop, red, eager, pressing forward, Agni I worship with repeated homage. Forming thyself with joints in proper order, harm not the Cow, Aditi widely ruling!

verses.sa: वरूत्रीं त्वष्टुर्वरुणस्य नाभिमविं जज्ञानां रजसः परस्मात्। महीं साहस्रीमसुरस्य मायामग्ने मा हिंसीः परमे व्योमन्॥
verses.tr: varūtrīṃ tvaṣṭurvaruṇasya nābhimaviṃ jajñānāṃ rajasaḥ parasmāt mahīṃ sāhasrīmasurasya māyāmagne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyoman
verses.en: Her who is Tvashtar's guardian, Varuna's' navel, the Ewe brought forth from out the loftiest region, The Asura's mighty thousandfold contrivance, injure not in the highest sphere, O Agni.

verses.sa: यो अग्निरग्नेरध्यजायत शोकात्पृथिव्या उत वा दिवस्परि। येन प्रजा विश्वकर्मा जजान तमग्ने हेडः परि ते वृणक्तु॥
verses.tr: yo agniragneradhyajāyata śokātpṛthivyā uta vā divaspari yena prajā viśvakarmā jajāna tamagne heḍaḥ pari te vṛṇaktu
verses.en: The Agni who from Agni had his being, from heat of Earth or also heat of Heaven, Whereby the Omnific One engendered creatures, him may thy fierce displeasure spare, O Agni.

verses.sa: चित्रं देवानामुदगादनीकं चक्षुर्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याग्नेः। आऽप्रा द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षं सूर्य आत्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च॥
verses.tr: citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ ā'prā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca
verses.en: The brilliant presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of Mitra, Varuija, and Agni. The soul of all that moveth not or moveth, the Sun hath filled the air, and earth and heaven.

verses.sa: इमं मा हिंसीर्द्विपादं पशुं सहस्राक्षो मेधाय चीयमानः। मयुं पशुं मेधमग्ने जुषस्व तेन चिन्वानस्तन्वो नि षीद। मयुं ते शुगृच्छतु यं द्विष्मस्तं ते शुगृच्छतु॥
verses.tr: imaṃ mā hiṃsīrdvipādaṃ paśuṃ sahasrākṣo medhāya cīyamānaḥ mayuṃ paśuṃ medhamagne juṣasva tena cinvānastanvo ni ṣīda mayuṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu
verses.en: Injure not, thousand-eyed, while thou art building for sacrifice, this animal, the biped. Accept as pith man's counterfeit the victim, Agni: there with building thy forms, be settled. Let thy flame reach man's counterfeit: i let thy flame reach the man we hate.

verses.sa: इमं मा हिंसीरेकशफं पशुं कनिक्रदं वाजिनं वाजिनेषु। गौरमारण्यमनु ते दिशामि तेन चिन्वानस्तन्वो नि षीद। गौरं ते शुगृच्छतु यं द्विष्मस्तं ते शुगृच्छतु॥
verses.tr: imaṃ mā hiṃsīrekaśaphaṃ paśuṃ kanikradaṃ vājinaṃ vājineṣu gauramāraṇyamanu te diśāmi tena cinvānastanvo ni ṣīda gauraṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu
verses.en: Harm not this animal whose hooves 'are solid, the courser neighing in the midst of coursers. I dedicate to thee the forest Gaura: building thy bodies up with him be settled. Let thy flame reach the Gaura, let thy flame reach him, whom we detest.

verses.sa: इमं साहस्रं शतधारमुत्सं व्यच्यमानं सरिरस्य मध्ये। घृतं दुहानामदितिं जनायाग्ने मा हिंसीः परमे व्योमन्। गवयमारण्यमनु ते दिशामि तेन चिन्वानस्तन्वो नि षीद। गवयं ते शुगृच्छतु यं द्विष्मस्तं ते शुगृच्छतु॥
verses.tr: imaṃ sāhasraṃ śatadhāramutsaṃ vyacyamānaṃ sarirasya madhye ghṛtaṃ duhānāmaditiṃ janāyāgne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyoman gavayamāraṇyamanu te diśāmi tena cinvānastanvo ni ṣīda gavayaṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu
verses.en: Thousandfold, 'with a hundred streams, this fountain, expanded in the middle of the waters, Infinite, yielding butter for the people, harm not, O Agni, in the highest region.. This wild bull of the forest I assign thee: building thy bodies up therewith be settled. Let thy flame reach the wild bull, etc.(as in).

verses.sa: इममूर्णायुं वरुणस्य नाभिं त्वचं पशूनां द्विपदां चतुष्पदाम्। त्वष्टुः प्रजानां प्रथमं जनित्रमग्ने मा हिंसीः परमे व्योमन्। उष्ट्रमारण्यमनु ते दिशामि तेन चिन्वानस्तवो नि षीद। उष्ट्रं ते शुगृच्छतु यं द्विष्मस्तं ते शुगृच्छतु॥
verses.tr: imamūrṇāyuṃ varuṇasya nābhiṃ tvacaṃ paśūnāṃ dvipadāṃ catuṣpadām tvaṣṭuḥ prajānāṃ prathamaṃ janitramagne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyoman uṣṭramāraṇyamanu te diśāmi tena cinvānastavo ni ṣīda uṣṭraṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu
verses.en: This creature clothed in wool, Varuna's navel, the skin of animals quadruped and biped, The first that "was produced of Tvashtar's creatures, O Agni, harm not in the highest region. The forest buffalo do I assign thee: building, etc., as above mutato mutando,

verses.sa: अजो ह्यग्नेरजनिष्ट शोकात्सो अपश्यज्जनितारमग्रे। तेन देवा देवतामग्रमायँस्तेन रोहमायन्नुप मेध्यासः। शरभमारण्यमनु ते दिशामि तेन चिन्वानस्तन्वो नि षीद। शरभं ते शुगृच्छतु यं द्विष्मस्तं ते शुगृच्छतु॥
verses.tr: ajo hyagnerajaniṣṭa śokātso apaśyajjanitāramagre tena devā devatāmagramāyaṃstena rohamāyannupa medhyāsaḥ śarabhamāraṇyamanu te diśāmi tena cinvānastanvo ni ṣīda śarabhaṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu
verses.en: From Agni's warmth the he-goat had his being: he looked at first upon his generator. Thereby the, Gods at first attained to Godhead: those meet for \worship to the height ascended. The forest $Sarabha do I assign thee: building, etc.

verses.sa: त्वं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄँः पाहि शृणुधी गिरः। रक्षा तोकमुत त्मना॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ yaviṣṭha dāśuṣo nṝṃḥ pāhi śṛṇudhī giraḥ rakṣā tokamuta tmanā
verses.en: Do thou, Most Youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs,' Protect his oflspring and himself.———..

verses.sa: अपां त्वेमन्त्सादयाम्यपां त्वोद्मन्त्सादयाम्यपां त्वा भस्मन्त्सादयाम्यपां त्वा ज्योतिषि सादयाम्यपां त्वाऽयने सादयाम्यर्णवे त्वा सदने सादयामि समुद्रे त्वा सदने सादयामि सरिरे त्वा सदने सादयाम्यपां त्वा क्षये सादयाम्यपां त्वा सधिषि सादयाम्यपां त्वा सदने सादयाम्यपां त्वा सधस्थे सादयाम्यपां त्वा योनौ सादयाम्यपां त्वा पुरीषे सादयाम्यपां त्वा पाथसि सादयामि गायत्रेण त्वा छन्दसा सादयामि त्रैष्टुभेन त्वा छन्दसा सादयामि जागतेन त्वा छन्दसा सादयाम्यानुष्टुभेन त्वा छन्दसा सादयामि पाङ्क्तेन त्वा छन्दसा सादयामि॥
verses.tr: apāṃ tvemantsādayāmyapāṃ tvodmantsādayāmyapāṃ tvā bhasmantsādayāmyapāṃ tvā jyotiṣi sādayāmyapāṃ tvā'yane sādayāmyarṇave tvā sadane sādayāmi samudre tvā sadane sādayāmi sarire tvā sadane sādayāmyapāṃ tvā kṣaye sādayāmyapāṃ tvā sadhiṣi sādayāmyapāṃ tvā sadane sādayāmyapāṃ tvā sadhasthe sādayāmyapāṃ tvā yonau sādayāmyapāṃ tvā purīṣe sādayāmyapāṃ tvā pāthasi sādayāmi gāyatreṇa tvā chandasā sādayāmi traiṣṭubhena tvā chandasā sādayāmi jāgatena tvā chandasā sādayāmyānuṣṭubhena tvā chandasā sādayāmi pāṅktena tvā chandasā sādayāmi
verses.en: I set thee in the passage of the waters. I set thee in the swelling of the waters. I set thee in the ashes of the waters. I set thee in the lustre of the waters. I set thee in the way which waters travel. I set thee in the flood, the place to rest in. I set thee in the sea, the place to rest in. I set thee in the stream, the place to rest in. I set thee in the water's habitation. I set thee in the resting-place of waters. I set thee in the station of the waters. I set thee in the meeting-place of waters. I set thee in the birthplace of the waters. I set thee in the refuse of the waters. I set thee in the residence of waters. I settle thee with the G&yatrl!.metre. I settle thee with the Trishtup metre. I settle the with the Jagati metre. I settle thee with the Anushtup metre. I settle thee with the Pankti metre.

verses.sa: अयं पुरो भुवस्तस्य प्राणो भौवायनो वसन्तः प्राणायनो गायत्री वासन्ती गायत्र्यै गायत्रं गायत्रादुपांशुरुपांशोस्त्रिवृत् त्रिवृतो रथन्तरं वसिष्ठ ऋषिः प्रजापतिगृहीतया त्वया प्राणं गृह्णामि प्रजाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ puro bhuvastasya prāṇo bhauvāyano vasantaḥ prāṇāyano gāyatrī vāsantī gāyatryai gāyatraṃ gāyatrādupāṃśurupāṃśostrivṛt trivṛto rathantaraṃ vasiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā prāṇaṃ gṛhṇāmi prajābhyaḥ
verses.en: This, in front, is Bhuva. His offspring, Breath, is Bhauv^yana. jana. Spring is Pr^o^yana. The Q&yatri is the daughter of Spring. From the Gayatri comes the Gayatra tune. From the Gayatra the Up^ipsa. From the Up&tpsu the Trivrit. From the Trivrit the Rathantara. The Rishi Vasishtha. By thee, taken by Prajapati, I take vital breath for creatures. S

verses.sa: अयं दक्षिणा विश्वकर्मा तस्य मनो वैश्वकर्मणं ग्रीष्मो मानसस्त्रिष्टुब्ग्रैष्मी त्रिष्टुभः स्वारं स्वारादन्तर्यामोऽन्तर्यामात्पञ्चदशः पञ्चदशाद् बृहद् भरद्वाज ऋषिः प्रजापतिगृहीतया त्वया मनो गृह्णामि प्रजाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ dakṣiṇā viśvakarmā tasya mano vaiśvakarmaṇaṃ grīṣmo mānasastriṣṭubgraiṣmī triṣṭubhaḥ svāraṃ svārādantaryāmo'ntaryāmātpañcadaśaḥ pañcadaśād bṛhad bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā mano gṛhṇāmi prajābhyaḥ
verses.en: This on the right, the Omnific. His, the Omnific't offspring, Mind. Summer sprang from Mind. The Trishtup is the daughter of Summer. From the Trishtup came the Svar song. From the Sv&ra the Antaryima. From the Antary&ma the Pailchadasa. From the Paftchtidaaa the Brihat. The ishi Bharadvaja. By thee, taken by Pra> Prajftpati, I take Mind for creatures.

verses.sa: अयं पश्चाद्विश्वव्यचातस्य चक्षुर्वैश्वव्यचसं वर्षाश्चाक्षुष्यो जगती वार्षी जगत्या ऋक्सममृक्समाच्छुक्रः शुक्रात्सप्तदशः सप्तदशाद्वैरूपं जमदग्निरृषिः प्रजापतिगृहीतया त्वया चक्षुर्गृह्णामि प्रजाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ paścādviśvavyacātasya cakṣurvaiśvavyacasaṃ varṣāścākṣuṣyo jagatī vārṣī jagatyā ṛksamamṛksamācchukraḥ śukrātsaptadaśaḥ saptadaśādvairūpaṃ jamadagnirṛṣiḥ prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā cakṣurgṛhṇāmi prajābhyaḥ
verses.en: H'his on the western side, tbe the All- Embracer. His, the All-Embracer's offspring, the Eye. The Rains sprang from the Eye. The Jagatt is the daughter of the Rains. From the Jagatt came the Rik.'Mma. From the Riksania the $Sukra. From the Sukra the Saptadasa. From the Saptadasa the Vairupa. The Rishi Jamadagni. By thee, taken by Prajipati, I take the Eye for creatures.

verses.sa: इदमुत्तरात् स्वस्तस्य श्रोत्रं सौवं शरच्छ्रौत्र्यनुष्टुप् शारद्यनुष्टुभ ऐडमैडान्मन्थी मन्थिन एकविंश एकविंशाद्वैराजं विश्वामित्र ऋषिः प्रजापतिगृहीतया त्वया श्रोत्रं गृह्णामि प्रजाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: idamuttarāt svastasya śrotraṃ sauvaṃ śaracchrautryanuṣṭup śāradyanuṣṭubha aiḍamaiḍānmanthī manthina ekaviṃśa ekaviṃśādvairājaṃ viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā śrotraṃ gṛhṇāmi prajābhyaḥ
verses.en: This on the north side, heaven. This, heaven's offspring, the Ear. Autumn, the daughter of the tlie Ear. The Anushtup sprang from Autumn. From the Anushtup came the Aida, From the Aida the Manthin. From the Manthin the Ekaviipfa. From the £Ekaviipsa the Vairaja. The Rishi VisviUnitra. By thee, taken by Prajdpati, I take the Ear for creatures.

verses.sa: इयमुपरि मतिस्तस्यै वाङ्मात्या हेमन्तो वाच्यः पङ्क्तिर्हैमन्ती पङ्क्त्यै निधनवन्निधनवत आग्रयण आग्रयणात् त्रिणवत्रयस्त्रिंशौ त्रिणवत्रयस्त्रिंशाभ्यां शाक्वररैवते विश्वकर्म ऋषिः प्रजापतिगृहीतया त्वया वाचं गृह्णामि प्रजाभ्यो लोकं ता इन्द्रम्॥
verses.tr: iyamupari matistasyai vāṅmātyā hemanto vācyaḥ paṅktirhaimantī paṅktyai nidhanavannidhanavata āgrayaṇa āgrayaṇāt triṇavatrayastriṃśau triṇavatrayastriṃśābhyāṃ śākvararaivate viśvakarma ṛṣiḥ prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā vācaṃ gṛhṇāmi prajābhyo lokaṃ tā indram
verses.en: This above, Intellect. Its, Intellect's offspring, Speech. Winter the offspring of Speech. Pankti sprang from Winter. From Pankti the Nidhauavat. From the Nidhanavat came the Agrayana. From the Agrayana the Trinava and the Trayastrimsa. From the Trinava and the Trayastriipsa the §&Sakvara and the Raivata. The? Bishi Visvakarman. By thee,.taken by Visvakarman, I take Speech for people. Fill up the room, etc. The dappled kine, etc. All.sacred songs, etc, three texts repeated from XII. 54—
